objective: Agregar canal controlado corregido de migracion SOLO Development para Gate 4 universal integrations. Este job solo instala workflow y rollback; no ejecuta el DDL. No tocar Production ni Worker/Supervisor.

actions.content:
name: Servers Integrations Universal Development Migration

on:
  push:
    branches: [Edarsahub_Desarrollo]
    paths: [ops/migrations/requests/SERVERS-INTEGRATIONS-UNIVERSAL-20260909.execute]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: servers-integrations-universal-development-migration
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  migrate-development:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: development
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST: ${{ vars.EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST }}
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT: ${{ vars.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT }}
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE: ${{ vars.EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE }}
      MIGRATION_SCRIPT: backend/database/migrations/20260909_001_servidores_integraciones_universal_infra.sql
      ROLLBACK_SCRIPT: backend/database/migrations/20260909_001_servidores_integraciones_universal_infra_rollback.sql
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {ref: '${{ github.sha }}'}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: '3.11'}
      - name: Install SQL runtime
        run: python -m pip install pymssql pydantic python-dotenv email-validator
      - name: Validate Development configuration
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${GITHUB_REF}" = 'refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo'
          test -n "${EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST:-}"
          test -n "${EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT:-}"
          test -n "${EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE:-}"
          test -f "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}"
          test -f "${ROLLBACK_SCRIPT}"
      - name: Preflight readonly
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p evidence
          python - <<'PY' | tee evidence/preflight.txt
          import os,pymssql
          conn=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD'],timeout=60,login_timeout=15)
          cur=conn.cursor(as_dict=True)
          cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sys.tables WHERE name IN ('Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Sync_Control_Evidencias','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos')")
          tables=cur.fetchall(); print({'existing_new_tables':tables})
          if tables: raise SystemExit('GATE4D_PREFLIGHT_TABLE_COLLISION')
          checks={
            'Unidades_Negocio':['timezone_iana','locale_operativo'],
            'Sync_Control_Ejecuciones':['ConexionID','UnidadNegocioID','CodigoSync','StartedAtUTC','FinishedAtUTC','IdempotencyKey'],
            'Servidores_ConexionEstado':['UltimaPruebaUTC','UltimoExitoUTC','UltimoErrorUTC','UltimoErrorCodigo','UltimoErrorMensaje','LatenciaMs','UltimoSyncUTC','UltimoSyncExitosoUTC','FechaActualizacionUTC']}
          for table,cols in checks.items():
              literals=','.join("'%s'"%c for c in cols)
              cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(%s) AND name IN (%s)" % ("'dbo.%s'"%table,literals))
              rows=cur.fetchall(); print({table:rows})
              if rows: raise SystemExit('GATE4D_PREFLIGHT_COLUMN_COLLISION:'+table)
          cur.close(); conn.close(); print('GATE4D_PREFLIGHT=PASS')
          PY
      - name: Verify writer permission
        env:
          MIGRATION_USER: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_USER }}
          MIGRATION_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "${MIGRATION_USER:-}"; test -n "${MIGRATION_PASSWORD:-}"
          echo "EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER=${MIGRATION_USER}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD=${MIGRATION_PASSWORD}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          python - <<'PY' | tee evidence/writer-permissions.txt
          import os,pymssql
          conn=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['MIGRATION_USER'],password=os.environ['MIGRATION_PASSWORD'],timeout=60,login_timeout=15)
          cur=conn.cursor(as_dict=True); cur.execute("SELECT COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(DB_NAME(),'DATABASE','CREATE TABLE'),0) can_create,COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo','SCHEMA','ALTER'),0) can_alter")
          row=cur.fetchone(); print(row); cur.close(); conn.close()
          if int(row['can_create'])!=1 or int(row['can_alter'])!=1: raise SystemExit('GATE4D_DDL_PERMISSION_NOT_CONFIRMED')
          PY
      - name: Execute transactional migration
        env: {EDARSAHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATIONS: 'true'}
        shell: bash
        run: PYTHONPATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/backend" python backend/tools/edarsahub_sql_runner.py --mode migrate --script "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}" 2>&1 | tee evidence/migration.txt
      - name: Postcheck exact schema
        id: postcheck
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY' | tee evidence/postcheck.txt
          import os,pymssql
          conn=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD'],timeout=60,login_timeout=15)
          cur=conn.cursor(as_dict=True)
          cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.tables WHERE name IN ('Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Sync_Control_Evidencias','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos')"); tables=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
          expected={'Unidades_Negocio':['timezone_iana','locale_operativo'],'Sync_Control_Ejecuciones':['ConexionID','UnidadNegocioID','CodigoSync','StartedAtUTC','FinishedAtUTC','IdempotencyKey'],'Servidores_ConexionEstado':['UltimaPruebaUTC','UltimoExitoUTC','UltimoErrorUTC','UltimoErrorCodigo','UltimoErrorMensaje','LatenciaMs','UltimoSyncUTC','UltimoSyncExitosoUTC','FechaActualizacionUTC']}
          col_count=0
          for table,cols in expected.items():
              literals=','.join("'%s'"%c for c in cols)
              cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.%s') AND name IN (%s)"%(table,literals)); col_count+=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
          cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.foreign_keys WHERE name IN ('FK_Sistema_Sync_Capacidades_Sync','FK_Sistema_Sync_Capacidades_Capacidad','FK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_Conexion','FK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_Unidad','FK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_CodigoSync','FK_Sync_Control_Evidencias_Ejecucion','FK_Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos_Unidad','FK_Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos_Sistema','FK_Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos_Version','FK_Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos_Conexion')"); fks=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
          cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.indexes WHERE name IN ('UX_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_IdempotencyKey','IX_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_Conexion_CodigoSync','IX_Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos_UnidadSistema','IX_Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos_Conexion')"); indexes=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
          cur.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.rows),0) n FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0,1) WHERE t.name IN ('Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Sync_Control_Evidencias','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos')"); rows=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
          print({'tables':tables,'columns':col_count,'fks':fks,'indexes':indexes,'rows':rows})
          cur.close(); conn.close()
          if (tables,col_count,fks,indexes,rows)!=(3,17,10,4,0): raise SystemExit('GATE4D_POSTCHECK_CONTRACT_MISMATCH')
          print('GATE4D_POSTCHECK=PASS')
          PY
      - name: Rollback if postcheck failed
        if: steps.postcheck.outcome == 'failure'
        env: {EDARSAHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATIONS: 'true'}
        shell: bash
        run: PYTHONPATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/backend" python backend/tools/edarsahub_sql_runner.py --mode migrate --script "${ROLLBACK_SCRIPT}" 2>&1 | tee evidence/rollback.txt
      - name: Fail after rollback
        if: steps.postcheck.outcome == 'failure'
        run: exit 1
      - name: Upload evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: servers-integrations-universal-development-migration-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: evidence/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30
